observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor stage or performance area with thatched backdrop and musicians behind, day
observation.dancers: group of women, mixed heights, dancing together
observation.formation_and_space: group formation, shifting between staggered lines and curving paths across the stage
observation.posture: upright torso with soft, slightly bent knees and grounded weight
observation.footwork: fast stepping on the spot and traveling steps matching the rapid drum beats; exact weight placement partially obscured by grass skirts
observation.arms_and_hands: arms held out to the sides or curved gracefully, with soft hand gestures at chest or waist height
observation.hips_and_torso: rapid, continuous hip shaking and side-to-side hip rotations (tamure) with upper body held relatively stable
observation.partnering: none, solo dancing within a group formation
observation.levels_jumps_turns: low to medium level, brief knee dips and squatting postures, minimal jumping, occasional pivoting turns
observation.costume_and_props: large red and white feathered headpieces, black bikini tops, dark skirts with natural fiber (raffia/grass) hip fringes, shell necklaces
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement and rapid weight shifts are partially obscured by the dense grass skirts and low-resolution video frames

signature_moments.what: dancers face away, rapidly shaking hips while stepping in place, then turn to face front with arms extended
group dips low into a squatting posture while maintaining rapid hip movement before rising
arms raised overhead in a sweeping arc while hips accelerate in rapid side-to-side rotations
